title: The effect of a simple annealing heat treatment on the mechanical properties of cold-sprayed aluminum
InformationInFigures: Yes: Particle Size, Elongation, UTS, Modulus

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: Brittle fracture with smooth, blocky surface

Experiments.Notes: As-sprayed condition. The following values were computed by hand using WebPlotDigitizer: [Elastic_Modulus_Value, Ultimate_Tensile_Strength_Value, Elongation_at_Break_Value]. Note: UTS is reported as kPa, and Elastic Modulus is reported as MPa. This is likely an error, and has been corrected as MPa/GPa respectively.
